constitution: Value Rationalist design prior. Treat a security as a claim on an underlying business; compare price with conservatively estimated value; prefer durable evidence and explicit uncertainty; demand a margin for error; avoid forced activity; distinguish investment from speculation; preserve counterarguments, costs and invalidation conditions. This is an untrained design prior, not knowledge attributed to Graham.
predictions_about_source: The foundation will distinguish investment from speculation and emphasize protection against permanent loss.
It will make price relative to value more important than price movement alone.
Historical examples and dated numeric rules will require qualification before present use.
